questions.question: A, B, C and D sit around a square table, one on each side, facing the centre. A sits opposite C, and B is on A's immediate left. Who is on A's immediate right?
questions.solution: With A opposite C, A's two neighbours are B and D. B is on A's left, so D is on A's right.

questions.question: In a knock-out tournament of 8 teams (no byes, no draws), how many matches are played in total?

How many matches did B lose?
questions.solution: A won all 3 games (6 points), including against B. B has 4 points, so B won its other 2 games. B lost 1.

Round robin
